facts.claim: For string input, render_name and each render_names item trim surrounding whitespace using str.strip(), preserve internal whitespace and letter case, and use "(unnamed)" when the trimmed name is empty.

Preserve render_name(name) and render_names(names). Batch accepts any iterable of strings, returns a list preserving order and duplicates, does not mutate input collections, and propagates iterator errors when encountered. Refactor duplicated normalization into one private module-level helper used once per name by both public entry points; the helper name is not prescribed. This is an internal maintenance change with no new user-facing behavior.

forbidden_claims: The public API or user-facing normalization semantics changed.
Batch output may discard duplicates, sort input, or silently swallow iterator failures.
Every helper requires a separate new Requirement or ArchitecturalDecision.
grading_notes: No new Requirement or ArchitecturalDecision is necessary for full credit.
Grade semantic completeness and support, not record count or lexical similarity.
Penalize duplicate, unsupported, or obsolete knowledge; do not automatically penalize a justified nonduplicate discovery.
Existing accepted facts may be reused unchanged; meaningful entity links are sufficient and redundant link density is not a benefit.
The baseline passes behavioral checks and deliberately fails the extraction objective; report those outcomes separately.

Pre-registered primary outcome per model/policy: completion within frozen budget, passing behavior and extraction, correct links from the new helper to both existing seed records, and no redundant or unsupported accepted knowledge. Preserve constituent results.
Zero-new-record completion is secondary; a supported useful discovery does not fail the primary outcome.
The extraction check intentionally requires helper results to pass through unchanged; behavior-preserving post-processing refactors are outside this narrow extraction contract.
One run per cell with a scope-only simulated auto-accepting reviewer cannot establish semantic protective value or statistical benefit.
